data.body: 3c2f broad validation note: beyond the already-approved test_atomic_completion_close::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head failure, the same atomic-close lifecycle file reproduces four additional pre-existing failures on a clean origin/main snapshot with the worktree venv and PYTHONPATH rooted at the archive: test_successful_push_followed_by_remote_rewrite_fails_closed, test_unrelated_remote_rejection_merges_and_rebuilds_private_candidate, test_lost_push_ack_is_confirmed_without_publishing_a_second_bundle, and test_post_push_convergence_preserves_concurrent_local_delivery_pending. Treat that entire file's FFFF.F pattern as unrelated baseline noise for this ticket; the rest of the default selector is being run with that file ignored to confirm no 3c2f regressions remain.
